data.script: Sofia: Welcome to the Fjord Club graduation, here at the lake! … Erik: Fifty units, hundreds of words, and only one flooded invention. Good statistics! … Valentina: Each explorer receives a green certificate with a golden fjord. … Mateo: And a chocolate medal. Mine is already… gone. … Sofia: Luna receives the Best Assistant diploma. She's wearing her red scarf! … Erik: Next year: Flyers, with the Aurora team! … Valentina: Three cheers for the Fjord Club! … Everyone: Hip hip… HOORAY!
